name: stunt_count
retail_role: Loaded from spuddata*.txt; shipped value 8

name: active_stunt_index
retail_role: -1 when no stunt is active; set on accepted input and cleared at the stunt return-to-Bad frame

name: loop_start_frame
retail_role: Loaded final timing pair first value; shipped value 44; exact-frame Bink seek target after movie end

name: pass_marker_frame
retail_role: Loaded final timing pair second value; shipped value 660; first encounter scores final stunt specially, second encounter starts end.bik

name: current_quality
retail_role: 0 Bad, 1 Normal, 2 Okay, 3 Good; also directly selects synchronized Bink stream and is added to score

name: pass_marker_hit_count
retail_role: Initialized 0; increments whenever primary Bink frame equals 660; 1 continues run, 2 starts end.bik

name: playback_phase
retail_role: 0 synchronized stunt run, 1 end.bik/result presentation, 2 activity complete

name: running_score
retail_role: Initialized 0; increments by current_quality at each scoring event

name: result_voice_latch
retail_role: Initialized 0; result one-shot branch sets -1 after playing result voice pool(s) and recording completion

name: stunt_windows
retail_role: Eight 16-byte records: Normal start, Okay start, Good start, end exclusive

name: return_to_bad_frames
retail_role: Eight frames loaded after timing windows

name: stunt_sound_matrix
retail_role: 8 stunts x 4 qualities x 5 candidate managed sound IDs

name: stunt_sound_trigger_frames
retail_role: Eight trigger frames from soundinfo.txt

name: bink_handles
retail_role: Five handles: bad.bik, normal.bik, ok.bik, good.bik, end.bik

name: bink_surfaces
retail_role: Five DirectDraw surfaces corresponding to the five Bink handles

name: background_surface
retail_role: Data\SubGameSpudSkate\minimised.bmp

name: score_digits_surface
retail_role: Data\SubGameSpudSkate\skatespudscore.bmp

name: normal_quality_overlay
retail_role: Data\SubGameSpudSkate\1.bmp; drawn at (267,415) when quality=1

name: okay_quality_overlay
retail_role: Data\SubGameSpudSkate\2.bmp; drawn at (267,415) when quality=2

name: good_quality_overlay
retail_role: Data\SubGameSpudSkate\3.bmp; drawn at (267,415) when quality=3
